quotes: _authorize_project_operation: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST authorize a service principal from persisted state, never from the actor value it was handed. Inside the same open transaction it MUST read the stored principal and reject through the concealment boundary when that principal is absent or not active, and when the stored principal's scope_mode is the GRANTED_PROJECTS member of = models.ProducerScopeMode it MUST also read that principal's grant for this project and raise the scoped not-found rejection when the grant is absent or not active. Skipping them authorizes any caller that can name a principal identifier, which is the one inbound machine path the product has.
